posts.title: Five Client Return Structures

copy.default:
Most appointment-led businesses do not have one retention problem.

They usually have a few small gaps across the client journey.

A past client never gets followed up.

An enquiry goes quiet before booking.

Someone finishes an appointment without their next one in the diary.

A no-show never gets recovered.

A regular client simply drifts past the point they would normally return.

That is why we built 222Emails around Client Return Systems.

The aim is simple: make it easier for more of the people who already know the business to come back.

The five areas we keep coming back to are:
→ Reactivation
→ Enquiry follow-up
→ Rebooking
→ No-show recovery
→ Retention nurture

Most businesses will already be doing some of these well.

The interesting part is finding the gaps where clients are quietly being lost.

Where do you think most appointment-led businesses lose the most clients: enquiries, rebooking, no-shows or dormant clients?
